plugin.name: Above All Else
plugin.description: Meet a vampiric Khajiit who claims he can see the ancient dead. Join him in this quest to "become above all else".

plugin.name: Baba Yaga and the Labyrinth
plugin.description: Fully voiced quest to discover the mysteries of a walking hut, a soul cairn maze, weeping angels, and a witch.

plugin.name: Bark and Bite
plugin.description: Uncover the origins of a mysterious tree within the Rift and choose if you wish to meddle in such affairs.

plugin.name: Before the End
plugin.description: Speak with a prisoner awaiting execution and learn all about his life's biggest regrets.

plugin.name: Beyond Skyrim - Bruma
plugin.description: Travel beyond the borders of Skyrim and explore Bruma, the northernmost county in Cyrodiil. Delve into Ayleid ruins, meddle in local affairs or explore the wilds - the journey begins now.

plugin.name: Calling the Watchmaker
plugin.description: Calling the Watchmaker is a quest mod featuring high quality voice acting and an extremely unique story that delves into the creation myth of the Elder Scrolls universe.

plugin.name: Depths of the Soul
plugin.description: Depths of the Soul features a rather helpful merchant who will aid the player by selling various items for dungeons.

plugin.name: Heart of the Reach
plugin.description: Delve into the depths of an underground swamp in the aid of a priest in order to heal the Heart of the Reach. Including a new quest, weapons, ring, spell and more.

plugin.name: Hunt for the Spectre
plugin.description: The Hunt for the Spectre is an Elden Ring inspired quest mod centred around Ren, a man who is hunting a serial killer known as the Spectre. The mod features multiple endings and incredibly high quality voice acting.

plugin.name: Moon and Star
plugin.description: A mysterious and powerful criminal has been spotted in Skyrim, his trail dogged by hunters from Morrowind. However, there may be more at stake than it seems, and this criminal may be familiar...

plugin.name: Moonpath to Elsweyr
plugin.description: Brought to you by An_Old_Sock, the author of the in-development Moonpath Reborn, Moonpath to Elsweyr is enjoying regular updates for the first time in five years. This is the most comprehensive Moonpath experience to date.

plugin.name: Olenveld
plugin.description: Olenveld is a new lands mod, the size of a small DLC, bringing the lore-rich location of Olenveld to Skyrim. It introduces a unique questline and an island recapturing system.

plugin.name: Once We Were Here
plugin.description: Once We Were Here is a short to medium sized quest mod that revolves around Sillas, a Bosmer scholar investigating the Falmer.

fileDependency.file: Once We Were Here - Quest Mod.esp

plugin.name: Project AHO
plugin.description: Project AHO is a large quest modification, comparable in size to a medium-sized DLC. Designed in the best traditions of Bethesda Game Studios, this mod adds to Skyrim a hidden settlement of Great House Telvanni. Determine its fate for yourself!

plugin.name: Siege at Icemoth
plugin.description: A small scale vanilla-esque new lands mod adding some new islands with new locations and dungeons in the Sea of Ghosts. As well as some unique items from The Elder Scrolls Blades.

plugin.name: Sirenroot
plugin.description: You and a team of divers are hired to scour ruins at the bottom of Lake Honrich. A dialogue-heavy quest with puzzles, platforming, and a focus on water mechanics.

plugin.name: Skyrim Extended Cut - Saints and Seducers
plugin.description: Return to the Shivering Isles in a fully-voiced overhaul of Skyrim's Saints and Seducers Creation.

fileDependency.file: Skyrim Extended Cut - Saints and Seducers.esp

plugin.name: Sleepwalking Into A Nightmare
plugin.description: Adds a new Daedric prince quest where you track down a missing woman, delving into her nightmares and overcoming her fears. Includes, new weapons, equipment and spells.

plugin.name: Taste of Death Addon
plugin.description: Adds new dialogue, enemies, and gameplay to the vanilla quest "The Taste of Death". Confront the cult of Namira and bring them to justice.

plugin.name: The Forgotten City
plugin.description: A critically acclaimed expansion mod offering a unique 6 - 8 hour experience: a murder mystery investigation set in an ancient underground city. You'll need to solve it using your wits, and the ability to travel through time.

plugin.name: The Frozen Heart
plugin.description: Step through a magical mirror into a cursed frozen realm. Explore labyrinths, solve puzzles, ponder orbs, battle shadows, and help an ancient Snow Elf warrior cure her curse.

plugin.name: The Gift of Saturalia
plugin.description: A fully voiced new quest. Help the people of Skyrim and spread the spirit of Saturalia.

plugin.name: The Gray Cowl of Nocturnal
plugin.description: Will you be worthy for the Gray Cowl of Nocturnal? We'll see!

plugin.name: The Rot Below
plugin.description: Discover the secrets of a mad lich who thought themselves a god. Explore an ancient palace, a subterranean city of the undead, and an insane warlock's research hall. Foil Namira's plans and stop the coming rot.

plugin.name: The Sinister Seven
plugin.description: The Sinister Seven is a backstory quest line. Seven Assassins are dispatched to kill the player, taking place across several levels.

plugin.name: The Tools of Kagrenac
plugin.description: Go on a quest to recover the legendary Tools of Kagrenac. Encounter new allies and enemies, explore sprawling dungeons, and add powerful new artifacts and spells to your arsenal in this fully-voiced quest mod!

plugin.name: There Is No Umbra - Chapter III
plugin.description: Includes Chapters I and II. Continue Daumbra's story, and obtain new gameplay mechanics (sword throwing, sword riding, mind control, teleportation, etc.) through a DLC-sized questline, professionally voiced. The story has many possible endings -your choices really do matter.

plugin.name: Unslaad
plugin.description: Quest mod of Half-Dragon. Add fluffy equipment and creatures.

plugin.name: Vigilant
plugin.description: Vigilant of Stendarr Quest.

plugin.name: War's Folly
plugin.description: Stumble across Sandor, a zealous preacher who seeks to convince Solitude's residents that the Civil War is one of folly. Hear his sermons and converse with the man, perhaps even you will begin to question your ideals.

plugin.name: Whispers of the Depths
plugin.description: Whispers of the Depths centres around an Argonian fisherman, Slays-Many-Beasts. Through the four encounters of this mod, he will tell tales of his time at sea, and the various monsters he encountered.

plugin.name: Wyrmstooth
plugin.description: A large DLC-sized quest expansion for Skyrim featuring a new island to explore, fully voice acted NPCs, new dungeons, new music, and a player home.

plugin.name: Caught Red Handed - Quest Expansion
plugin.description: Mind your own business, Svana. Everyone should be allowed to practice the "Dibellan" arts free of shame! Expands this misc quest with some new... interesting outcomes.

plugin.name: College of Winterhold - Quest Expansion
plugin.description: This mod provides 7 new starter magic lessons/quests to make your College of Winterhold feel like an actual school of magic.

plugin.name: Defeat the Dragon Cult
plugin.description: This mod aims the expand the later half of the main quest by giving the Dragonborn a reason to fight and kill all of the Dragon Priests in Skyrim before facing Alduin at the Throat of the World.

plugin.name: Destroy the Acolyte Priests
plugin.description: A quest to hunt down and destroy the three Dragon Priests on Solstheim who were Acolytes of Miraak (not including Vahlok the Jailor).

plugin.name: Destroy The Dark Brotherhood - Quest Expansion
plugin.description: This mod introduces new lore-friendly ways to get kidnapped by Astrid (allowing you to Destroy the Dark Brotherhood even after sparing Grelod) while also expanding the actual quest to destroy the DB with new dialogue, choices, more memorable fights and a more cohesive quest. Enjoy!

fileDependency.file: Destroy the Dark Brotherhood - Quest Expansion.esp

plugin.name: Forsworn Conspiracy - Quest Expansion
plugin.description: Greatly expanded the Forsworn Conspiracy questline to give new choices, new roleplaying opportunities, new epic stories. Over 200 new lines.

plugin.name: Ill Met by Moonlight - Dialogue Expansion
plugin.description: Defy the will of Hircine while still serving justice to Sinding. A fully voiced mini-expansion of the namesake quest using voice actors or spliced lines.

plugin.name: Infiltration - Quest Expansion
plugin.description: One of the most underwhelming vanilla quests... turned into an epic quest full of player choice.

plugin.name: Innocence Lost - Quest Expansion
plugin.description: This mod provides new paths (both good and evil) to complete the first Dark Brotherhood quest. Grelod the Kind, you'd better watch out. Fully voiced as usual.

plugin.name: Nilheim - Misc Quest Expansion
plugin.description: Fixes some issues with the misc quest at Nilheim and gives a bit more flexibility to your encounter with good old Telrav, adding a couple of additional dialogue choices and options for roleplaying.

plugin.name: Paarthurnax - Quest Expansion
plugin.description: A fully voiced, quite expanded new take on the quest Paarthurnax, giving both the Blades and Paarthurnax good reasons for their stances, and you, Dragonborn, the final choice.

plugin.name: Penitus Oculatus
plugin.description: A quest where you can join the Penitus Oculatus after the vanilla "destroy the dark brotherhood" quest and get all the rewards.

plugin.name: Return Aegisbane
plugin.description: Who needs an old Iron Warhammer anyway? Adds the option to return Aegisbane to it's rightful owners... Or tell them that you're claiming it as your own.

plugin.name: Revealing Rune
plugin.description: Rune of the Thieves Guild has always felt like he was meant to have some sort of story or quest. But alas, hours of searching along the coast of Solitude will yield no results. Well, that is until now! Help Rune search for information on his past and discover what happened to his parents.

plugin.name: Save the Icerunner
plugin.description: Jaree-Ra in Solitude has a plan to set up a shipwreck. The ship is said to be full of weapons and riches, ripe for the taking. What will you do?

plugin.name: The Heart of Dibella - Quest Expansion
plugin.description: Tired of having to break into a ladies-only religious building just to start this quest? This mod has you covered with new roleplaying opportunities, more dialogue and more choices.

fileDependency.file: The Heart Of Dibella - Quest Expansion.esp

plugin.name: The Whispering Door - Quest Expansion
plugin.description: Experience a longer version of Mephala's Daedric quest, now with more dialogue, more decisions and a general darker approach to the original quest.

plugin.name: Thieves Guild Alternative Endings
plugin.description: Defy Nocturnal and unlock yourself from eternal servitude. Adds 4 new voice-acted endings to the Thieves Guild questline, including new story, new rewards, new boss fights.

plugin.name: Thieves Guild For Good Guys
plugin.description: Ever wanted to join the Thieves Guild without sending people to jail or bullying people for money? Want to tell Maven off? Want Mjoll to like you without having to lie to her about the Thieves Guild? Want to be a Robin Hood type thief?

plugin.name: Inigo
plugin.description: Inigo is a fully voiced khajiit adventuring companion with over 7000 lines of unique dialogue - much of it about you. He'll level alongside you and avoid most traps.

plugin.name: Kaidan 2
plugin.description: Rebuilt and expanded, this romantic follower features over 1200 lines of dialogue, custom home, and mini quests.

plugin.name: Lucien
plugin.description: Lucien is a fully voiced Imperial follower with over 6000 lines of immersive, lore-friendly dialogue. Though he arrives in Skyrim as a cowardly scholar, he'll gradually gain strength and confidence by your side until he grows into a hero in his own right.

plugin.name: M'rissi's Tails of Troubles
plugin.description: Fully immersive and lore-friendly story with 8 hours of quests, more than 2000 voiced lines and 3 different endings. Choose your path and decide her fate.

plugin.name: Remiel
plugin.description: Adds Remiel to your game, custom voiced with ~5,000 lines of dialogue, a Breton engineer who will accompany you in your travels. She's travelled from Wayrest to explore dwemer ruins in Skyrim, but she needs your help.

plugin.name: Song of the Green - Auri
plugin.description: A standalone, custom-voiced follower and quest mod.

plugin.name: Thogra
plugin.description: Help an Orc widow get revenge on the one who wronged her. The same Thogra gra-Mugur, now with a new voice!

plugin.name: Xelzaz
plugin.description: Xelzaz is a Custom Fully Voiced Argonian Lawman of House Telvanni with ~8500 lines. He has just arrived in Skyrim and is looking for a traveling companion. In return he will keep you company, cook you warm meals and brew powerful potions.

plugin.name: Bards Reborn - Student of Song
plugin.description: This mod gives the Bards College a massive makeover, adds a new study quest, new bardic powers, and new characters to flesh out your experience as a student in the Bards College.

plugin.name: Become a Bard
plugin.description: Tired of being a warrior or mage? Become a Bard!

plugin.name: Aetherium Forge Destroys Items
plugin.description: This mod allows you to destroy items by dropping them in the lava at the Aetherium Forge.

plugin.name: Daedric Shrines AIO prayer activators
plugin.description: Statues of Daedric Lords.

plugin.name: Legacy of the Dragonborn
plugin.description: Not just a display mod, not just a quest mod, not just a new guild mod, but a complete foundational flagship mod to build an entire load order around. This DLC expansion sized mod adds hundreds of new items, dozens of new quests and hundreds of extra hours of play.
